title: Reagan diary on the capacity to put 300 people in orbit
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Reagan diary on the capacity to put 300 people in orbit, about 1980s at United States (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
You have Reagan diary entries
from the 80s saying I you know met with
top astronomers from from NASA

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that diary entries written by Ronald Reagan, the US president in the 1980s, record him meeting top astronomers from NASA, the US space agency. As the story is told, the entries mention a capacity to put 300 people in orbit, which would mean the country could do far more in space than the public was told.
